title: Polynomial Bound for the Host Ledger
statement: For natural numbers $C,c,B,A,d,n,T$, if $T\le B(n+1)^{c+1}$, then $2n+2+T+(n+C(n+1)^c+2+(A(n+C(n+1)^c+1)^d+1))\le (B+A+5)(n+C(n+1)^c+1)^{c+d+1}$.
replaced: For all natural numbers $C, c, B, A, d, n$ and $T$ with $T \le B(n+1)^{c+1}$, the total $2n + 2 + T + (n + C(n+1)^c + 2 + (A\,(n + C(n+1)^c + 1)^d + 1))$ is at most $(B + A + 5)\,(n + C(n+1)^c + 1)^{c+d+1}$.
